new_libraries.name: EasyIO
new_libraries.author: Mirco Spaggiari <EasyProjects85@proton.me>
new_libraries.sentence: A library for PCF8574A (8-bit) and PCF8575 (16-bit) I2C I/O expanders used on a custom PCB that provide input read (State ON 4 to 30V) and relay output.
new_libraries.paragraph: EasyIO simplifies the control of PCF8574A and PCF8575 expanders using active-LOW output logic. It prevents chip damage and short circuits by automatically enforcing input bits LOW during operations, avoiding incorrect pin state conflicts.

library.name: Terminal
library.author: John J. Gavel <john.gavel@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Terminal for Serial Ports, Telnet, and other Streams.
library.paragraph: Processing, Parsing, Executing, and Output Control for Terminals. Provides the ability to easily add commands to Terminals, Execute commands, and Parse and Tokenize the Input. Handles backspace and up/down arrows from history.
